## Usage notes

# Logos

The Phantom: one hooded figure, faceted like a low-poly model (isometric precision), with crimson eye slits, framed by an isometric hex portal and cut by a crimson Trash Polka brush stroke. Original artwork for Phantom Portals.

| File | Use |
|---|---|
| `phantom-emblem.svg` | Primary emblem on white / canvas. Hero artwork, splash, about. Min 96px. |
| `phantom-emblem-inverse.svg` | Emblem on its own matte-black square (white frame, rim-lit hood). Dark heroes, boot screens. |
| `phantom-lockup.svg` | Emblem + wordmark, horizontal. Headers, documents, installer banners. Min height 40px. |
| `phantom-wordmark.svg` | Wordmark alone: PHANTOM in `ink-primary`, PORTALS in `accent-crimson`, brush underline in `accent-hero`, mono subline. Text is outlined Space Grotesk / JetBrains Mono. |
| `phantom-monogram.svg` | Hood + slash only, for 16–64px (favicons, tabs, rail). The emblem's frame and splatter drop out below 96px. |
| `phantom-app-icon.svg` | Monogram on black for app/launcher icons and drive icons. |

Inks: `#151519` (ink-primary), `#A0112B` (accent-crimson), `#B8143E` (accent-hero), `#EE5367` (accent-electric, laser line only), white on inverse.

Clear space: half the emblem's height on every side. Don't recolour the hood, add a second character, put the emblem on busy art, or stretch it.
